correctness.rationale: The exact quantifier-free tuple diagram is encoded by distances truncated at two. The coordinate-orbit recursion enumerates all possible next moves, including equal vertices. The four-copy coordinate-cell lemma preserves all four-vertex atomic diagrams in both directions; the two-block cap-eight lemma then proves root types stabilize for all dimensions at least sixteen. Complete integer enumeration of dimensions 1–16 yields six sharp classes, and an unrelated direct graph-tuple computation agrees in dimensions 1–5. The infinite conclusion uses the mathematical lemmas, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Quantifier-rank-four expressive power on dimension-growing Boolean cubes is a natural finite-model-theoretic benchmark. This provides a complete all-dimension partition with the unexpected dimension-six stabilization and the optimal 64-vertex representative. It separates a single rank-three tail into three distinct rank-four regimes, with structural saturation lemmas explaining why dimension growth eventually becomes invisible; the claim is neither a renamed graph fact nor a single arbitrary small enumeration.
